title: How Does Your Body Feel Today?
caption: Feeling jittery today, with quick starts and sudden dips? The day has a bumpy-sidewalk feel—active enough to nudge the nerves, yet still in the middle lane. Take 3–5 minute off-ramps between tasks, and use light moves—an easy walk or stretch—to keep pace.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity is elevated compared with recent quiet days. The solar wind is in a normal range, and the magnetic field has been pointed south. No new flare activity or burst events are on the board.
affects: Primary pattern: wired/tired. You may feel keyed up, with quick starts followed by sudden dips. Transitions can feel rough, and settling after stimulation may take longer than usual.
playbook:
- Take 3–5 minute off-ramps between tasks
- Light movement breaks: an easy walk or stretch
- Hydrate and keep snacks simple and steady
- Pull back on late-day screens and loud input
